root@d70c05ff175c:/app# cat > /usr/local/bin/curl << 'PYEOF'
> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> import sys, urllib.request, urllib.error, ssl
>
> def main():
>     args = sys.argv[1:]
>     verbose = False; silent = False; head = False; output = None; url = None
>     headers = []
>     if any(a in ('--version','-V') for a in args):
>         print('curl 8.x-replacement (python urllib wrapper)'); return 0
>     i = 0
>     while i < len(args):
>         a = args[i]
>         if a == '-v': verbose = True
>         elif a == '-s': silent = True
>         elif a in ('-I','--head'): head = True
>         elif a == '-o': i += 1; output = args[i]
>         elif a == '-L': pass
>         elif a == '-X': i += 1
>         elif a.startswith('-H'):
>             h = a[2:] if a != '-H' else args[i+1]
>             if a == '-H': i += 1
>             if ':' in h: headers.append(h)
>         elif a.startswith('-'):
>             pass
>         else:
>             url = a
>         i += 1
>     if not url:
>         sys.stderr.write('curl: try \'curl --help\' for more\n'); return 2
>     req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=('HEAD' if head else 'GET'))
>     for h in headers:
>         k, v = h.split(':', 1); req.add_header(k.strip(), v.strip())
>     try:
>         resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
>         if verbose or head:
>             sys.stderr.write('HTTP/%s %s %s\n' % (resp.version//10, resp.status, resp.reason))
>             for kk, vv in resp.getheaders():
>                 sys.stderr.write('%s: %s\n' % (kk, vv))
>             sys.stderr.write('\n')
>         data = resp.read() if not head else b''
>         if output:
>             with open(output, 'wb') as f: f.write(data)
>         elif not silent:
>             sys.stdout.buffer.write(data)
>         return 0
>     except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
>         sys.stderr.write('HTTP error %s: %s\n' % (e.code, e.reason)); return 22
>     except Exception as e:
>         sys.stderr.write('curl: (%s) %s\n' % (type(e).__name__, e)); return 6
>
> if __name__ == '__main__':
>     sys.exit(main())
> PYEOF

> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> import sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
>
> def main():
>     args = sys.argv[1:]
>     verbose = False; silent = False; head = False; output = None; url = None
>     headers = []
>     if any(a in ('--version','-V') for a in args):
>         print('curl 8.x-replacement (python urllib wrapper)'); return 0
>     i = 0
>     while i < len(args):
>         a = args[i]
>         if a == '-v': verbose = True
>         elif a == '-s': silent = True
>         elif a in ('-I','--head'): head = True
>         elif a == '-o': i += 1; output = args[i]
>         elif a.startswith('-'):
>             if a == '-H':
>                 i += 1
>                 if ':' in args[i]: headers.append(args[i])
>             elif a.startswith('-H') and ':' in a[2:]:
>                 headers.append(a[2:])
>         else:
>             url = a
>         i += 1
>     if not url:
>         sys.stderr.write("curl: try 'curl --help' for more\n"); return 2
>     if '://' not in url:
>         url = 'http://' + url
>     req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=('HEAD' if head else 'GET'))
>     for h in headers:
>         k, v = h.split(':', 1); req.add_header(k.strip(), v.strip())
>     try:
>         resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
>         if verbose or head:
>             sys.stderr.write('HTTP/%s %s %s\n' % (resp.version//10, resp.status, resp.reason))
>             for kk, vv in resp.getheaders():
>                 sys.stderr.write('%s: %s\n' % (kk, vv))
>             sys.stderr.write('\n')
>         data = b'' if head else resp.read()
>         if output:
>             open(output,'wb').write(data)
>         elif not silent:
>             sys.stdout.buffer.write(data)
>         return 0
>     except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
>         sys.stderr.write('HTTP error %s: %s\n' % (e.code, e.reason)); return 22
>     except Exception as e:
>         sys.stderr.write('curl: (%s) %s\n' % (type(e).__name__, e)); return 6
>
> if __name__ == '__main__':
